This is my recreation of a model created by Fabien Ernst (https://skfb.ly/6yypu) which he based off a concept drawing of a spider tank for Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.  I did this during the Hard Surface Modeling and Advanced Materials classes at Platt College-San Diego.

results.name: CPA Basemodel
results.description:
Finished basemodel of my CPA Agent. This is without any additive variation models attached. There is a really rough rig on the model. I used modern day tank commander helmets as inspiration for the helmet, UN Peacekeeping forces for the color scheme, and plate armor designs from medieval knights for the armor.

Uses 2K textures. 
Modeled in Blender.
Textured in Substance Painter.
Photoshop used for various decals and stencils.

results.name: High-Mobility Self-Propelled Artillery Prototype
results.description: High-Mobility self-propelled artillery prototype. Humanoid-torso mounted to a gravity displacement field-effect propulsion module. Intended for long-range installation defense scenarios --- wholly unsuited for short range and melee combat. Standard humanoid manipulator mounted on the left arm. Right arm replaced with a high-output positron cannon, powered by an external micro-fusion reactor mounted on the left shoulder. Advanced sensor module mounted between shoulders provides enhanced long-range target acquisition and tracking.
